note: THE DEPLOY GATE, ONE ROW PER @curated TEST (v1.263.0, GATE5; the owner's U147 a, 12 Nov 2026: "only what a deploy can break, plus one quick test per surface"). Tier D: the deploy build differs here (the keyed Supabase and PostHog config, the affiliate stamp, the checkout's own history, the static shells crawlers read). Tier S: one smoke per surface on the exact merged tree. Every other journey runs in e2e-full.yml's core shards on every PR and every push to dev; a promotion takes only a commit whose push-run e2e-full is green. Until v1.263.0 the tag meant 'a fast representative sample' and grew from 427 tests (1 Oct) to 914 (12 Nov), 33.6 to 36.8 min of a 45-min step timeout; this trim kept 56 and untagged 858, each of which still runs unchanged in e2e-full (the GATE1 plan, reports/gatetime.md outside the repo, has the per-file keep table). TO ADD A TEST to the gate, tag it AND add its row: file (relative to e2e/journeys), Playwright's full title as the list reporter prints it (describe › test), tier, the reason a deploy can break it and a PR run cannot see it, and ci_s null until a deploy measures it (it counts at the measured rows' p90 meanwhile). Checked by tests/deploy_gate.test.mjs in test:units (tag sites against rows, the budget in deploy_gate_budget.json) and by `node scripts/deploy_gate.mjs check --listed` in e2e-full's build job (Playwright's own selection, title for title). Seconds move only by hand: `node scripts/deploy_gate.mjs refresh --log <gate log> --run <id>`.
